description: LINK-TXN from a second process: a creates a source file (table SRC, 4 rows) and a host with a link LK, closes both, then opens the host shared, BeginTrans and inserts through LK; process b opens the SOURCE file directly (shared, read-only, reopened for each read) and counts SRC and records any error, once while a's transaction is open, once after a's Rollback, once after a's second transaction commits and again 8 s later. Asks what another process sees of a link participant's uncommitted, rolled back and committed rows.
retentionNote: Designed r-q2-ado-misc probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
